QuestInfo.name: Stranger in a Strange Land
QuestInfo.0: You followed the foxes and somehow arrived at Fox Point Village. You don't seem to fit in with the Pointy-Ear Foxes. Talk to Moonbeam.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam said she got in trouble for bringing in a stranger, even though you are helpless like a little lost puppy. She also said her grandfather, Chief Silver, is in charge of everything around town. He might be the person...fox...thing to talk to.
QuestInfo.2: Silver was fixated on your lack of ears and tails. You kept saying it's fine, but he wouldn't listen to you. He's being awfully nice, though...

0.0: Actually, I got in a lot of trouble with the grown-ups. They said I can't trust strangers, and that you might be dangerous. But look at you! No claws, no fangs. You're like a tasty bunny.
0.1: The grown-ups still said no. They don't care how soft or flabby or delicious you are. If you're going to get anything done here, I guess you'll need to talk to my grandpa. He's the oldest guy in town!

yes.0: Oh, and my grandpa hates rude folks! So be extra polite when you meet him. Or else.

no.0: Don't worry, human. My grandpa's so old, he can't even chew meat that well. You're probably safe. Probably.

0.msg: So, you're this new-fangled 'human' causing the stir around here. My goodness, just look at you! No ears, no tail... What a pity. You probably can't even feed yourself, poor thing.

1.msg: Look, this is all a big misunderstanding. Where I'm from-

2.msg: I'm sure you're very special where you're from, child. But here, we really must take care of you before you become someone's snack. Ah, I know what we'll do. You can stay in the abandoned home for now. I doubt the neighbors will eat you there.

4.msg: No, no, it's no trouble at all. Us foxes are a very warmhearted kind. Even sickly-looking prey like you, we treat with dignity and respect. Now, see that house over there? That's where you'll stay. Make yourself at home.

npc.0: Don't worry, human. My grandpa's so old, he can't even chew meat that well. You're probably safe. Probably.
